claim.claim-text: 2. The device according to claim 1, wherein the control device is configured such that the hole punching and the hole forming operation takes place substantially simultaneously.
3. The device according to claim 1, wherein the control device is configured such that the punch sleeve forms an abutment for the embossing sleeve during the hole-forming operation.

4. The device according to claim 1, wherein a centering pin is moveable against the feed direction within the embossing sleeve, and wherein the control device is configured such that after the first stage the centering pin is moved into the formed hole.

5. The device according to claim 1, wherein the embossing sleeve is moveable with the aid of a mechanical linkage, and wherein the mechanical linkage has a knee lever mechanism, and wherein the embossing sleeve is moved against the workpiece by actuating the knee lever mechanism to form the deep-drawn collar.

6. The device according to claim 1, wherein the control device is configured such that the embossing sleeve is moved back into a retracted position before the connecting element is pressed in, and wherein the embossing sleeve forms an abutment for the connecting element during the setting process.
7. The device according to claim 6, wherein the embossing sleeve is moveable into the retracted position against a second fixed stop.
8. The device according to claim 1, wherein the hold-down device has a first fixed stop that bears against a stop surface of the feed unit during the punching and hole-forming operation

9. The device according to claim 1, wherein the feed unit has a plunger, a spring element and a plunger tube that receives the plunger and the spring element, wherein the setting unit is fastened to the plunger tube, wherein the plunger moves against the punch, wherein the spring element acts on the hold-down device and the punch is further designed as a sleeve in which an ejector pin is guided so as to be displaceable relative to the punch sleeve.

10. A device for carrying out a setting process for setting a connecting element on a workpiece, the device comprising: a setting unit that comprises: a punch that is moveable in a feed direction relative to the hold-down device for punching a hole in the workpiece; and a punch sleeve for pressing the connecting element into the hole, wherein the punch and the punch sleeve are connected to one another via an axial forced guidance for a common feed movement in the feed direction, the axial forced guidance being able to be released in a controlled manner, so that the punch is moveable relative to the punch sleeve for the hole punching operation.

11. The device according to claim 10, wherein the punch sleeve and the punch are adapted to be rotated relative to one another, so that in a predetermined rotational position the axial forced guidance is released and the punch is movable relative to the punch sleeve for performing the punching operation.

12. The device according to claim 10, wherein the punch sleeve and the punch are adapted to be rotated relative to one another with the aid of a drive unit that is controllable freely, a rotation taking place with the aid of a driver that engages in the punch sleeve or the punch.

13. The device according to claim 10, wherein the plunger sleeve is guided in the feed direction within the hold-down device in a rotationally secure manner up to a predetermined axial position at which the axial forced guidance is released by rotating the plunger sleeve.

14. The device according to claim 10, wherein front and retracted driver stops are formed on the punch sleeve and on the punch, wherein the front driver stops are disengaged for releasing the forced guidance by rotating the plunger sleeve.
